title: Lena and the Wolf
author: Emrys Okonkwo
blurb: Odile Kavanagh, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
